title: Evaluation comparisons preserving both adjunction maps
statement: Let $X,Y,x,y$ be categories and let $L:X\to Y$ and $R:Y\to X$ have a specified adjunction $a:L\dashv R$, with unit $\eta$ and counit $\epsilon$. Let $l:x\to y$ and $r:y\to x$ have a specified adjunction $b:l\dashv r$, with unit $\eta^b$ and counit $\epsilon^b$ [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. For functors $E:X\to x$ and $F:Y\to y$, an adjunction evaluation datum consists of natural isomorphisms $\lambda:F\circ L\cong l\circ E$ and $\rho:E\circ R\cong r\circ F$ such that, for every $A\in X$ and $B\in Y$, $r(\lambda_A)\circ\rho_{LA}\circ E(\eta_A)=\eta^b_{EA}$ and $\epsilon^b_{FB}\circ l(\rho_B)=F(\epsilon_B)\circ\lambda_{RB}^{-1}$. Both isomorphisms are part of the datum, and both equations concern the units and counits of the specified adjunctions; no existence of such a datum is asserted.
